service.method: SELECT HOUSE_CODE AS CLIENT_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , COMPANY_NAME FROM USERVICE WHERE COMPANY_CODE = '1000' AND HOUSE_CODE = $S{HOUSE_CODE} AND (HOUSE_CODE LIKE '%' + UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' OR COMPANY_NAME LIKE '%' + UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%') AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY HOUSE_CODE ASC
